verdict.rationale: Docusign offers its own programmatic surface for running without the UI: an eSignature REST API, an official Node.js client library, published OpenAPI specs, and an official MCP server. It also documents pairing with Gemini CLI to automate agreement processes from the terminal, and community users report building production services on the API. However, nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines or non-interactive authentication specifically. missing for 10: official first-party CLI, documented non-interactive/service-account auth for CI runners, CI integration guides or examples, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
